aspect: Selectivity is invisible from inside one case
description: The target sees one enforcement. Proving inconsistency requires data about other cases, which the target has no right to.
energy_note: You would need everyone else's file to prove it.

description: Every unit on the row has a van in the loading bay. Only his gets the notice. When he raises it: 'I can only act on what I see.' The officer has walked past four other vans to write it.
energy_note: Four other vans, and one ticket.

description: Correcting the cited breach produces enforcement of a different rule, because the rule was the instrument rather than the objective.
energy_note: Fix it and the next rule arrives.

aspect: It teaches the target they are being watched
description: The lasting effect is not the penalty but the knowledge that somebody is looking specifically at them, which changes how they behave in every unrelated respect.
energy_note: Knowing, from now on, that you are the one being watched.
